summary: # Marvelous Designer 2024: Auto Convert to Avatar In this video, we will quickly introduce the Auto-Convert to Avatar feature, new in Marvelous Designer 2024.0. ## Overview of Auto-Convert to Avatar You can automatically convert avatars created in other software to the default avatar in Marvelous Designer. To begin, click on **Main Menu**, then select **Avatar**, and choose **Auto-Convert to Avatar**. ## Importing Avatars In the Auto-Convert to Avatar pop-up window that opens, load the avatar from the original file. Note that you can import avatars in **ABT**, **OBJ**, and **FBX** file formats. We recommend using avatars in an **A pose** for optimal results. ## Selecting Default Avatar Type Next, select the default avatar type for gender based on the Marvelous Designer presets. You can convert them to default avatars for: - Women - Men - Boys - Girls - Children - Babies ## Conversion Options The converting option allows you to select between **automatic** or **custom**, which maintains the current rig. For avatars imported from other software, we recommend choosing **custom**. ### Excluding Hands and Feet When the **Exclude Hands and Feet** option is selected, the Marvelous Designer avatar's hands and feet will be retained when transforming the avatar's body shape. ### MD Skin Style and Rigging Options When selecting **MD Skin Style** from the **Converted Type**, this keeps the avatar's body shape. It retains the original avatar's body type and converts only its appearance to the Marvelous Designer avatars, but it adds joints. When **Rigging Only** is selected, it adds joints while maintaining the avatar's body shape and appearance. ### Editable Size Option When **Size Editable** is selected, it changes the avatar's body shape and adds joints in Marvelous Designer while allowing for size editing, all while keeping the original avatar intact. ## Saving Your Avatar In the **File Name** field, you can specify a name for the avatar that you want to save. In the **File Path** field, you can specify the path to the location where you want to save this new avatar. Click the **Convert** button to convert your chosen avatar format. When you select **Open the Folder**, you'll see the avatar file in the saved path that you specified. ## Viewing the Converted Avatar I'm going to press the **Close** button to see it right in the 3D window. You will see that your avatar has been converted into the three converted types that appear in the 3D window. ## Importing FBX Files This time, we will import an **FBX** file with no breaking settings and convert it back to the 3D window. You can do this by checking the **MD Skin Style** and **Rigging Only** options. Note that for avatars without rigging settings, Marvelous Designer will automatically set the default avatar rigging shape for you. ## Changing Avatar Size You can also change the avatar size to the default avatar size. Because they are the same shape as the default avatars, you can use arrangement points as well. ## Accessing Marvelous Designer Features The converted avatar now gives you access to the features in Marvelous Designer, such as basic motion, soft body simulation, and more.
